claims.text: Miraval Arizona is set across 400 acres of the Sonoran Desert.

findings.quote: Welcome to Miraval Arizona, set across 400 acres of serene Sonoran Desert under nearly year-round sunshine.

claims.text: The resort stretches against the Santa Catalina Mountains just north of Tucson.

findings.quote: The resort is spread across 400 acres of Sonoran Desert, stretching against the Santa Catalina mountains just north of Tucson.

claims.text: All meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies and non-alcoholic beverages are included, with an additional charge for premium zero-proof cocktails.

findings.quote: That's right, all meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies, and non-alcoholic beverages are included, Additional charge for hand-crafted, premium Zero Proof Cocktails.

claims.text: Stays include full access to the Life in Balance Spa.

findings.quote: Full access to the Life in Balance Spa

claims.text: Spa treatments range from acupuncture to Ayurveda to water-based sessions in a private pool.

findings.quote: Everything from a long acupuncture list to Ayurveda to water-based sessions in a private pool.

claims.text: Stays include a nightly resort credit that can be applied to spa services, fee-based activities or private sessions.

findings.quote: Nightly Credit
Resort credit can be applied to spa services, fee-based activities, or private sessions

claims.text: The resort offers an extensive menu of daily workshops, classes, lectures and activities, many of them complimentary.

findings.quote: We offer an extensive menu of daily workshops, classes, lectures, and activities, many of which are complimentary.

claims.text: Most activities are available as private one-on-one sessions with specialists.

findings.quote: Most of our activities are available as private sessions, which give you the opportunity to work one-on-one with our world-class specialists

claims.text: Miraval Immersions are multi-day masterclass programs created by specialists.

findings.quote: Explore your wellness goals or specific intentions with exclusive multi-day masterclass programs created by expert specialists.

claims.text: Guest rooms have in-room meditation channels and a Himalayan singing bowl.

findings.quote: Enjoy personal time with in-room meditation channels, and your Himalayan singing bowl.

claims.text: Accommodation ranges from standard rooms to multi-bedroom villas.

findings.quote: Accommodation options range from a standard room to multi-bedroom villas for the ultimate indulgence.
No tips needed. Miraval is a gratuity-free resort

claims.text: The Retreats have at least 600 square feet, an indoor/outdoor shower and a patio with a private in-ground hot tub.

findings.quote: look at booking one of the Retreats
With at least 600 square feet of space, these come with a spacious indoor/outdoor shower along with a patio where a bubbling, private in-ground hot tub awaits.

claims.text: Guests can hike up Mt. Lemmon, try therapeutic drumming and spend time with horses at Purple Sage Ranch.

findings.quote: Go hiking up Mt. Lemmon, try therapeutic drumming, spend an afternoon bonding with our equine friends at Purple Sage Ranch.

claims.text: Most of the property is a screen-free zone, and guests receive a linen sleeping bag for storing digital devices.

findings.quote: Miraval welcomes everyone checking in with a linen sleeping bag for storing digital devices, and the majority of the property is set up as a screen-free zone.

claims.text: The Vasudhara spa service combines Thai stretches, bodywork and a warm water float.

findings.quote: This transformative service eases muscles with Thai stretches, bodywork, and a gravity-defying warm water float.

claims.text: Miraval welcomes guests aged 18 and older.

findings.quote: Miraval welcomes guests who are 18+ years or older.

claims.text: The resort sits almost an hour from Tucson International Airport; stays include a shared shuttle from the airport.

findings.quote: almost an hour from Tucson International Airport
Ground, shared shuttle transportation from Tucson International Airport

claims.text: Guests may check in as early as 11 a.m., but rooms may not be ready until several hours later.

findings.quote: Guests are encouraged to check in as early as 11 a.m. on the day of arrival
note that your room may not be ready until several hours later
